steps.en: Install the package (or load it from a CDN script tag)
steps.zh: 安装这个 npm 包（或用 CDN 标签引入）
steps.code: npm install driver.js · yarn add driver.js

steps.en: Import the factory and its stylesheet in your app
steps.zh: 在你的应用里导入工厂函数和样式表

steps.en: Declare the tour as a steps array: selector + popover copy
steps.zh: 把引导声明成 steps 数组：选择器加气泡文案

steps.en: Create the instance and start driving
Dims the page, cuts a spotlight around each element, positions the popover with prev/next/close
steps.zh: 压暗页面、围绕元素挖出聚光、定位带上下步/关闭的气泡

steps.en: Advances as the user clicks Next or uses the keyboard, firing your lifecycle hooks
steps.zh: 随用户点 Next 或键盘推进，并在各阶段回调你的 hook

value.en: A framework-free product tour or one-off spotlight with zero runtime dependencies
value.zh: 零运行时依赖、不绑定框架的产品引导或单点聚光
